title: Helper configuration (for distinct)

comments.body: Hi @vvo, thanks for your reply. I was under the impression that searchParameters were going away though as they were exposing too much of the inner workings of the library (#1106). Or does this apply just for faceting parameters and the other parameters (like distinct) are still ok to be set that way?

@mlbrgl we're not set about what we're gonna do exactly. Still we are following semver so we're not gonna break inside a major version, therefore if we propose an alternative Api it'll at least coexist with this method inside the current major.
Right now they are not going away anytime soon so you are fine.
Alright, thank you both for the clarification.
@Braidio did you set up the attributeForDistinct in your settings?

Yes, and I've tried a few different attributes.. the most common of which
was a `title` :

```
.set_settings({
              attributeForDistinct: 'title',
              attributesForFaceting: [
                'filterOnly(_tags)'
              ]
            })
```
